patch_description:
Expand the deterministic search from two nearly identical starts into a compact portfolio of progressively stronger asymmetric perturbations, including unequal initial radii.  The optimum for a square is governed by a boundary-sensitive contact graph, and a single near-rectangular seed can repeatedly converge to the same local graph.  The additional starts expose alternative broken-symmetry contact patterns while remaining far below the timeout.

Candidates are now compared after applying the same global feasibility scale used for the returned solution.  This prevents a nominally higher but slightly infeasible SLSQP iterate from being selected over a genuinely better valid construction.
